error.TIME_ORDER: Going home cannot come before arriving.
error.PAY_TERMS_DATED: Pay from that date is already set. Use a later date, or add a line on the month with a reason.
owner.driverShort: The driver took {got} at delivery. {left} is still owed.
owner.tally.sub: Tally stays the books. This shows what has arrived and what has not.
owner.tally.techOnly: The technical role sees only this status.
owner.tally.noWrite: Nothing is written to Tally or the khata.
owner.tally.empty.body: The khata works as usual. Tally numbers appear here once a PC is connected.
owner.tally.empty.step1: On the PC that runs Tally, install the ShivBridge program. It only reads Tally.
owner.tally.empty.step2: Press Connect a PC here. You get an 8-digit code that lasts 15 minutes.
owner.tally.empty.step3: Enter the code on that PC.
owner.tally.empty.step4: The company appears here. Say it is the real books, and copying starts.
owner.tally.empty.notYours: An owner or the technical person connects the PC. Nothing for you to do yet. Once it is connected, you link parties here.
owner.tally.empty.prepare: One thing that helps now, in Tally:
owner.tally.noPrimary: No company has been chosen as the books yet, so there is nothing here.
owner.tally.noPc: No PC is connected. Tally numbers stay as they last came.
owner.tally.pauseAllBody: Every PC stops asking Tally within about a minute. The khata keeps working, and Tally numbers here stay with their old time.
owner.tally.cutOffBody: It stops reaching the system at once, and what it sent just before is not read. To use it again you need a new code. Nothing in Tally changes.
owner.tally.state.PAIREDBody: It is connected and has not spoken yet. Enter the code on that PC and start the program.
owner.tally.state.PC_ASLEEPBody: Last heard {when}. It sends by itself when it wakes. Nothing for you to do.
owner.tally.state.TALLY_CLOSEDBody: Open Tally on this PC and load the company.
owner.tally.state.PORT_OFFBody: The accountant turns this on once in Tally:
owner.tally.port.prime: TallyPrime: F1 > Settings > Connectivity > Client/Server Configuration. Set Acts as to Both or Server, port 9000.
owner.tally.port.erp9: Tally.ERP 9: F12 > Advanced Configuration. Restart Tally if it asks.
owner.tally.state.NO_COMPANYBody: Load the company in Tally. F1 > Settings > Startup can open it by itself each day.
owner.tally.state.COMPANY_MISSINGBody: Not open: {name}. F1 > Settings > Startup can open it by itself each day.
owner.tally.state.BUSYBody: Slowest answer {seconds} seconds. It waits and asks again.
owner.tally.state.BAD_ANSWERBody: It tries again by itself. If this keeps happening, tell the technical person.
owner.tally.state.PAUSEDBody: It asks Tally nothing until someone starts it again.
owner.tally.state.SPOOL_FULLBody: Its store of unsent data is full. Check this PC's internet.
owner.tally.state.EDUCATIONALBody: Tally is not in licence mode. Tell the accountant.
owner.tally.pair.name: Name for this PC
owner.tally.pair.once: Shown only this once. It works one time, until {time}.
owner.tally.pair.howTo: On that PC, as administrator, run:
owner.tally.pair.then: The company then appears on this page within a minute or two.
owner.tally.company.pendingBody: Nothing is copied from this company until someone says what it is.
owner.tally.company.pendingAsk: Ask the accountant which file is the real books.
owner.tally.company.pendingNotYours: An owner or the technical person decides this. Tell them which file is the real books.
owner.tally.company.primaryBody: Its parties and vouchers start copying here. Nothing in Tally changes. It can take a while.
owner.tally.company.leaveBody: Its Tally numbers stop showing on customers at once. Linked parties stay linked.
owner.tally.company.pcGone: Its PC was cut off. Choose another.
owner.tally.company.sameName: A company of this name was here before. This may be a restore or a migration, so ask the accountant first.
owner.tally.company.none: The PC is connected but no company has shown yet. Open Tally and load a company.
owner.tally.oldCopy: This copy is old: last updated {when}. Numbers may have changed in Tally since.
owner.tally.tie.FAILED: {failed} of {total} parties do not agree with Tally
owner.tally.tie.UNSETTLED: Tally was being written to during the check. It checks again.
owner.tally.tie.REWRITTEN: Tally's data changed, checking it all again
owner.tally.tech.title: Technical details
owner.tally.tech.releaseBad: That file could not be read.
owner.tally.tech.releaseAdded: Version {version} added. It reaches no PC until chosen.
owner.tally.party.search: Search a Tally party by name
owner.tally.party.none: No parties have arrived from Tally yet.
owner.tally.party.allDone: Every party is dealt with. Nothing left to link.
owner.tally.link.title: Link {party}
owner.tally.link.search: Name or area of the customer
owner.tally.link.none: No customer found. Add one by phone below.
owner.tally.link.new: Or a new person, by phone
owner.tally.link.name: Name
owner.tally.link.help: If this number already has an account, that account is linked and its name stays.
owner.tally.farq.sub: Khata minus Tally, for each linked customer. What has no reason comes first.
owner.tally.farq.none: No differences. Every linked customer agrees with Tally.
owner.tally.farq.noneLinked: No customer is linked yet, so there is nothing to compare.
owner.tally.farq.copying: Tally is still copying. Differences are hidden until it finishes, as they would only mislead.
owner.tally.line.TIMING: In the khata, not in Tally yet. Under a week old, so this is usual.
owner.tally.line.APP_ONLY: In the khata, not in Tally for a week or more. The accountant enters it, or the khata entry is reversed.
owner.tally.line.TALLY_ONLY: In Tally, not in the khata.
owner.tally.line.AMOUNT: In both, with different amounts. Correct the side that is wrong.
owner.tally.line.OPENING: The gap at the start, not agreed yet.
owner.tally.line.OPENING_SIGNED: The gap at the start, agreed on the opening sheet.
owner.tally.numbers.title: Khata and Tally
owner.tally.numbers.signHelp: Plus means the khata is higher, minus means Tally is higher.
owner.tally.numbers.addsUp: These lines add up to the difference exactly.
owner.tally.numbers.notAddsUp: These lines do not add up to the difference. Tell the technical person.
owner.tally.numbers.stale: This Tally number is old: up to {when}.
owner.tally.numbers.rewritten: Tally's data changed and is being checked again, so do not rely on this number yet.
owner.tally.numbers.suggest: These look like the same thing
owner.tally.numbers.suggestShort: Khata entry and a Tally voucher: {amount}
owner.tally.numbers.voucherGone: Tally has since deleted this voucher. Undo this to match the entry again.
owner.tally.numbers.unlinkBody: Its Tally balance stops counting for this customer. Nothing in Tally or the khata changes.
owner.tally.numbers.linkHelp: Link this customer to their Tally party, and both numbers show here.
customer.order.refunded: Your payment has been refunded. This order will not be delivered.
customer.reply.accepted: You accepted. The shop will make the order.
